title: Sacred Andhra Pradesh: 6 Days Across AP Temples
overview: Eleven darshans across Andhra Pradesh, from Kanaka Durga on Indrakeeladri hill in Vijayawada to Simhachalam in Visakhapatnam — following the Krishna and Godavari through some of the state’s most important pilgrimage centres.
The route includes Pancharama shrines, Bhadrachalam’s Sri Rama temple and the coastal temples of the north. A private vehicle, a tour manager, stays and all meals are included.

highlights.title: Kanaka Durga
highlights.text: Hilltop shrine overlooking the Krishna in Vijayawada

highlights.title: Bhadrachalam
highlights.text: Sri Sita Ramachandra Swamy Temple on the Godavari

highlights.title: Pancharamas
highlights.text: Amararama and Draksharama, ancient Shiva shrines

highlights.title: Simhachalam
highlights.text: Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Temple near Vizag

itinerary.title: Arrival in Vijayawada | Kanaka Durga Darshan
itinerary.subtitle: Overnight: Vijayawada
itinerary.intro: Arrive at Vijayawada Airport, meet your vehicle and tour manager, and check in.

Kanaka Durga darshan
activities.text: Around three and a half hours.

activities.title: Amararama Temple
activities.text: One of the five Pancharama Shiva shrines.

activities.title: RK Beach
activities.text: Evening by the sea. Dinner and overnight stay.

activities.title: Kailasagiri
activities.text: Hilltop park with views over the city and coast.

activities.title: Check-out
activities.text: Drop-off at Visakhapatnam airport or railway station.

good_to_know.title: Dress code
good_to_know.text: Traditional or modest clothing is recommended at all temples. Footwear is removed before entering.

good_to_know.title: What to carry
good_to_know.text: A valid photo ID, comfortable walking shoes, a water bottle and any regular medication.

good_to_know.title: Physical activity
good_to_know.text: Some shrines involve steps or hill climbs. Tell us about mobility needs and we’ll plan accordingly.

good_to_know.title: Best time to visit
good_to_know.text: October to March offers pleasant weather. Festival dates may affect crowds and darshan times.

faqs.question: Where does the tour start and end?
faqs.answer: The tour starts at Vijayawada Airport on Day 1 and ends in Visakhapatnam.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can add or skip temples, change hotel categories, or extend your stay. Share your preferences when you enquire.

faqs.question: Is this tour suitable for senior citizens?
faqs.answer: Yes. Travel is by private vehicle and the pace is comfortable. Tell us about any mobility needs in advance.

faqs.question: Are special darshan tickets included?
faqs.answer: No, special darshan tickets are not included, but our team can help you book them where available.
